summary.text: Gabriel Cervantes is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Ray Roll.
An operations manager, he defeated incumbent Jacque Phillips in the Democratic primary on June 30, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gabriel Cervantes was born in Thornton, Colorado, and graduated from Thornton High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2024.
His career experience includes working as an operations manager and in the food service industry, from tipped worker to general manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Cervantes said he is a co-founder of the Six-Siblings Foundation, an educational non-profit serving underrepresented students in South Thornton.
He said he has served on the RTD Citizen Advisory Committee representing Thornton, the Thornton Arts, Humanities and Sciences Council, and the Thornton High School Accountability Committee.
He said he is running on a platform that being pro-worker is also pro-business.
